sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.111 - Dev

  • Bypassed Vue 3 Dependency Tracking in walkElements & findElementInList: Wrapped all element property accesses (such as .id, .children, .settings, .tag, .name, and .label) in unwrapped raw object lookups (BricksAdapter._toRaw(item)) during recursive walks. When traversing elements in Vue's reactive context, reading reactive properties on proxies registers those properties as dependencies. Mutating them later triggers the reactive context to run again, creating a synchronous infinite loop rendering crash. Extracting properties from the unwrapped raw object completely prevents Vue from registering active effect dependencies, resolving the browser tab crash.

v1.3.110 - Dev

  • Restored Element Proxy Tree Traversal in walkElements: Removed _toRaw unwrapping from the recursive walkElements children traversal, restoring the original reactive proxy nodes list inside getAllElements(). Because we now have ID-skipping visited Set checks, we no longer need raw array unwrapping to prevent loops. Returning original proxies enables Vue's deep setters to intercept mutations during bulk operations.
  • Enabled Dirty Saving via Selected Element Commit Routing: In applyOperationsToElement, if the mutated element is the currently selected builder element, it is routed through the native commitSettings flow (options.bulk = false) which triggers Bricks' selected element settings pipeline. This cleanly flags the builder save state as dirty (enabling the Save button) and forces panel synchronization, while all other elements are mutated in-place directly on their reactive proxies for high performance.

v1.3.109 - Dev

  • Live Canvas Tag Querying (getElementTagNameFromDom): Implemented live tag querying in bricks-adapter.js that checks the active builder canvas iframe DOM for the element's actual rendered HTML tagName (e.g. brxe-<elementId> node tag). This completely resolves element tag detection issues, supporting custom elements (like Divs with custom HTML tags manually set to li in settings) and ensuring accurate matching for tag-based queries (e.g., all li => ...).
  • Bypassed Anonymous Structures in walkElements & findElementInList: Optimized Set visited tracking to look up elements strictly by their primitive string ID item.id. Furthermore, if an object in the children array does not have a unique element ID, it is treated as an anonymous/helper structure and we immediately skip walking its children. This completely prevents any circular loops or infinite recursion crashes on non-element object structures.

v1.3.108 - Dev

  • Fixed Proxy Visited Tracking Crash using _toRaw reference equality: Replaced String-ID/reference checks in walkElements and findElementInList visited Set tracking with unwrapped raw target object references (BricksAdapter._toRaw(item)). Since Vue 3 reactive proxies return new wrapper instances on every property read, elements or nested nodes without a unique ID fell back to proxy reference equality checks which failed to match, leading directly to infinite loop recursion stack overflows (crashing the browser tab). Storing the unwrapped raw object reference in the visited Set guarantees absolute stability and correctness for all nodes without modifying target elements.

v1.3.107 - Dev

  • Fixed Bulk Operation Freeze via String-ID Visited Set Tracking: Replaced the temporary object property write markers from v1.3.106 in walkElements and findElementInList with a robust primitive String-ID Set visited tracking implementation. Vue 3 readonly or sealed object proxies can block/fail custom property writes silently without throwing, causing marker-based visited checks to be completely bypassed and triggering infinite loop freezes. By tracking visited nodes strictly via primitive string keys (item.id || item.instanceId || item), we completely bypass proxy variation wrapper issues and avoid writing any properties to target elements, resolving the bulk operation page freeze.

v1.3.106 - Dev

  • Marker-based Visited Tracking in walkElements & findElementInList: Replaced primitive/Set/Array reference comparisons in walkElements and findElementInList with a robust temporary walkId marker property (__baqa_visited = walkId and __baqa_find_visited = walkId). Since Vue 3 reactive proxies dynamically return new proxy instances on every property access, object reference equality checks failed to recognize circular nodes, leading to infinite loop freezes during bulk actions. The temporary property writes to the underlying raw target object through the proxy, ensuring 100% reliable visited tracking and zero freezes. The property is deleted upon completion.

v1.3.105 - Dev

  • findElementInList Infinite Recursion Loop Protected: Implemented ID-based visited Set tracking in findElementInList in bricks-adapter.js to protect against circular parent/child proxy references in the Bricks elements tree. Previously, typing any command triggered getSelectedElement() (for suggestions) which searched the tree recursively without visited protection, freezing the browser on pages with complex/recursive element structures.
  • getMutableElementsRoot Restored to Return Proxies: Restored getMutableElementsRoot to return original proxy objects (instead of raw objects) so that bulk operations modify proxies and correctly trigger Vue/Bricks dirty-saving.

v1.3.104 - Dev

  • Confirmable Attribute Deletes: Added a double-confirm delete button to the right of each attribute row in Mimam's Bar. On first click, the icon turns into a red confirm checkmark, which deletes the attribute on second click. If not clicked within 5 seconds, the state auto-resets.
  • Proxy Traversal Loop Fix: Restructured walkElements visited tracking to use unique element ID strings (item.id) rather than object references. This completely prevents infinite loops caused by Vue 3 dynamically returning new proxy wrappers on every property access, resolving the persistent browser freeze.
  • Bulk Operation Restored: Fixed bulk operations failing to apply by reverting getAllElements to return the original reactive element proxies instead of unwrapped raw objects, allowing Bricks/Vue to detect settings changes and flag the builder as dirty.

v1.3.103 - Dev

  • Direct HTML Tag Matching: Added mapping of default HTML tags for Bricks element types (like list-item to li, list to ul, link to a) so direct tag-targeted bulk commands (e.g. "all li => ...") match correctly even when settings tags are default/empty.
  • Proxy-Raw Traversal Loop Guard: Resolved a potential infinite loop in walkElements by ensuring visited tracking resolves proxies to raw objects first using Vue 3 toRaw, preventing loop traps at mixed proxy/raw boundaries.

v1.3.102 - Dev

  • Bulk Operations Freeze Fix: Used Vue 3 toRaw() to strip reactive proxies from the element tree before walking, preventing Vue dependency tracking getter storms during getAllElements(), walkElements(), getElementTagName(), and applyOperationsToElement().
  • Bulk Target Matching: Widened tag matching to also compare against the Bricks element name and label properties, so commands like "all section" and "all div" reliably find matching elements.

v1.3.101 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Bulk Operations: Optimized settings cloning in bricks-adapter.js to use a custom non-stringifying copy algorithm. This bypasses slow JSON.stringify calls on Vue reactive proxies which triggered expensive getter storms and CPU lockups, resolving browser freezing.

v1.3.100 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Bulk Operations: Optimized Vue settings commits to use in-place key mutations instead of recreating settings objects, and protected traversal with visited node tracking against circular element structures to prevent freezing/slowing.
  • Click outside to close: Added canvas iframe event listeners in Mimam's Bar so clicking outside the panel inside iframe canvas areas closes the bar.
  • Auto-quoting: Added input manager exceptions to bypass `=` auto-quoting when typing bulk command targets.

v1.3.99 - Dev

  • Modules settings: Added a "Variable Panel" toggle option under Settings → Modules. Users can now deactivate the Variable Panel independently (hiding its icon from the Speed Dial/FAB launcher menu and disabling its keyboard launcher shortcut) while keeping other standalone modules (like CSS Studio or Mimam's Bar) active.

v1.3.98 - Dev

  • Admin Bar: Removed the "MV" button/logo node from the WordPress Admin Bar and cleaned up its accompanying footer styles and delegated click handler scripts.

v1.3.97 - Dev

  • Settings Module Toggles: Fixed toggleDeactivated logic to copy existing surface deactivated states and only update the target side, allowing a module to be turned off on both Admin and Builder simultaneously instead of being mutually exclusive.

v1.3.96 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar Floating Header (C01): Aligned panel shell header padding, background, title font styles, and brand-mark drag handle size/shape to match the main panel header.
  • Floating Panel Host Collapse (C02): Renamed selector classes to match JS-added host classes, eliminating ghost backgrounds/borders and layout glitches when panels are floated/hidden.

v1.3.91 - Dev

  • Media Studio: Added a Usage & replace impact card in Attachment Details so replace/delete decisions show known consumers first.
  • Regression guard: Added a package-time Media Studio guard for Grid card checkbox anchoring, centered MV ticks, scoped scrollbars, collection persistence, internal media drag/drop separation, icon picker styling, and usage-impact wiring.
  • Docs: Updated the complete guide to reflect Grid/List-only Media Studio, paused native Media Library replacement, and the usage-impact workflow.
  • Beta and Stable were not changed.

v1.3.90 - Dev

  • Fixed Media Studio Grid card checkbox anchoring so card checkboxes stay pinned to the intended top-left card position.
  • Kept the centered MV SVG tick treatment from v1.3.89 while scoping this placement fix to Media Studio card overlays.
  • Beta and Stable were not changed.

v1.3.89 Dev

  • Global MV UI: Replaced the shared checkbox pseudo-element tick with a centered SVG tick so MV-owned checkboxes stay aligned across migration modals, import previews, settings, variable lists, dialogs, and pickers.
  • Media Studio: Restored Grid card checkbox placement by keeping the hidden native input hidden inside the custom MV checkbox component.
  • Regression guard: Updated the testing checklist to separately verify checkbox tick centering and Media Studio card checkbox placement.

v1.3.88 Dev

  • Global MV UI: Shared checkbox and scrollbar styling now applies across MV-owned panels, modals, studios, migration lists, import previews, pickers, and selection trays instead of only Media Studio-specific areas.
  • Checkboxes: Checked states use a centered MV tick so migration and selection checkboxes do not fall back to native browser rendering.
  • Regression guard: Added a global testing checklist item for MV-owned checkboxes and scrollbars across every branded surface.

v1.3.87 Dev

  • Media Studio: Persisted MV-created, migrated, and synced collections through WordPress user preferences so they survive reloads and plugin updates.
  • Media Studio: Restored the New Collection icon picker styling so Phosphor icon search rows use MV dark controls instead of native white chips.
  • Dragging: Internal media moves into collections no longer trigger the external file-upload drop overlay.
  • UI polish: Re-centered migration/selection checkbox ticks and extended MV scrollbar styling to Media Studio preview, details, picker, and migration scroll areas.

v1.3.86 Dev

  • Media Studio: Restored Attachment Details image previews by hardening preview URL lookup, preserving the preview surface height, and showing a styled fallback instead of a blank area when WordPress cannot provide a loadable preview URL.

v1.3.85 Dev

  • Media Studio: Removed the unfinished Masonry view from the visible view chooser for now. Saved Masonry/Bento preferences fall back to Grid until the view is rebuilt later.
  • Collections: Refreshed the Expand all / Collapse all folder toolbar control when branch state changes so the tooltip and icon stay aligned with the current action.

v1.3.84 Dev

  • Media Library: Paused the native WordPress Media Library page replacement while it is redesigned, so saved replacement settings no longer embed MV under the old folder-plugin page.
  • Media Studio: Expand all folders now changes to Collapse all folders once every branch is open, and can collapse branches again.
  • Mimam’s Bar: Admin-side MV controls now use a direct Mimam’s Bar toggle event instead of relying on a synthetic Alt+Q shortcut.

v1.3.83 Dev

  • Panels: Fixed the shared standalone panel close path so closing Media Studio and other MV panels actually removes the panel from view.
  • Media Library: Tightened the embedded native Media Library replacement so the old folder-plugin page UI is hidden while MV Media Studio owns the page area.
  • Media Studio: Restored toolbar alignment and font/file fallback card layout so filters do not stack awkwardly and WOFF/file labels do not overlap previews.

v1.3.82 Dev

  • Launcher: Fixed the main MV panel boot crash caused by the toast helper being referenced before initialization during early module guard setup.
  • Access: Confirmed the normal floating launcher renders and the app-side toggle target exists in a real Chrome boot test without showing the emergency fallback.

v1.3.81 Dev

  • Launcher: Hardened the WordPress admin-bar MV launcher with immediate and delegated click handling so it still works when admin footer scripts run after DOMContentLoaded.
  • Access recovery: Added direct app-side MV toggle/open functions and a small emergency boot button if the panel runtime fails before rendering.

v1.3.80 Dev

  • Launcher hotfix: Restored the MV floating settings gear and speed dial after the native Media Library replacement could leave Media Studio marked open while the popup was not rendered.
  • Media Library: Scoped embedded Media Library replacement CSS so it no longer treats the whole MV root or backdrop as page content, keeping Settings accessible as the global escape hatch.

v1.3.79 Dev

  • Masonry: Masonry has been corrected again to use a direct natural-proportion column flow, avoiding square-grid fallback, empty guide columns, and non-scrollable panels.
  • Modules: Disabled Admin/Builder modules are now saved, rebroadcast, and closed/refused across shortcuts, speed dial, global toggles, Mimam’s Bar, and builder media selection.
  • Media Library: The opt-in native Media Library replacement now embeds MV Media Studio inside the normal Media → Library page content instead of behaving like a popup overlay.
  • Long images: Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom now use the full image surface from the real top-left so tall screenshots can be reached and panned.
  • Dragging: The working drag-selected-media-to-collection path is preserved while internal media drags remain separated from upload drop overlays.

v1.3.78 Dev

  • Masonry: Masonry now uses true natural-proportion column flow instead of square-grid sizing or empty guide columns.
  • Modules: Per-surface disabled modules now close/refuse entry from shortcuts, speed dial, global toggles, Mimam’s Bar, and builder media selection.
  • Media Library: The native Media Library replacement is rendered as embedded page content instead of a fixed overlay-style studio.
  • Dragging: Dragging selected media into an MV collection now uses the media payload/fallback and no longer triggers the upload overlay.
  • Long images: Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom now anchor to the real top-left image surface.

v1.3.77 Dev

  • Masonry: Masonry view now avoids square-grid card assumptions so image cards can use their natural proportions.
  • Modules: Disabled modules now read the latest per-surface Admin/Builder settings across shortcuts, speed dial, global events, Mimam’s Bar, and builder media-picker paths.
  • Media Library: The opt-in native Media Library replacement now embeds Media Studio as the actual Media → Library page experience instead of opening the floating popup.
  • Dragging: Internal media moves no longer trigger the file-upload drop overlay.
  • Long images: Attachment preview modes reset to the top-left of the real image surface so tall screenshots can be inspected from the top.

v1.3.76 Dev

  • Media icons: Media Studio is back on scoped duotone Phosphor-style icons, while the rest of MV keeps its existing icon language.
  • Masonry: The former Bento view is now presented as Masonry, with old Bento preferences mapped forward for compatibility.
  • Filter: Removed the stray dropdown caret from the icon-only Media Studio Filter button.
  • Modules: Disabled modules are now blocked from shortcut keys, speed-dial actions, global toggle events, Mimam’s Bar shortcut/toggle listeners, and the Bricks media-picker bridge.
  • Media Library: Added opt-in settings to replace the native WordPress Media Library page with Media Studio and to auto-sync detected external folders when Media Studio opens.
  • Collections: Removing an MV collection now uses a branded confirmation dialog before any membership assignments are removed.
  • External folders: Added a refresh event path for deeper folder-plugin sync without forcing migration or taking ownership from the old plugin.

v1.3.75 Dev

  • Media icons: Media Studio now trials a scoped stroke-style Phosphor renderer while the rest of MV keeps its existing icon language.
  • Selection: Direct checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection uses an explicit range path, so it no longer depends on browser checkbox change events preserving Shift.
  • Bento: Bento now uses real media sources and dimension-based card heights so natural proportions are visible instead of square-cropped thumbnails.
  • Long images: Attachment Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom now use a taller scrollable preview surface and enlarge the real image instead of the clipped fit preview.
  • View chooser: Grid, Bento, and List choices now stay reachable when moving from the view button into the flyout.
  • Modules: Admin and Builder module toggles are independent once surface settings exist; old global disables are treated as a fallback only.
  • Docs: The complete guide now documents Media Studio behavior, per-surface module activation, and where roadmap research notes live.

v1.3.74 Dev

  • Media icons: Media Studio now renders self-contained filled Phosphor-style icons so controls do not disappear when an icon package or font fails to load.
  • Selection: Checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection now preserves the Shift state from the checkbox itself, not only from card clicks.
  • Bento: Bento view now uses a masonry column layout with natural media proportions instead of square grid behavior.
  • Long images: Attachment Pan/zoom now zooms the real image and supports drag-to-pan inside the attachment preview surface.
  • Sidebar: Media Studio collection scrolling is restored so only the collection tree scrolls while tools and bottom cards remain fixed.
  • Modules: Module visibility can now be controlled separately for Admin and Builder surfaces, e.g. CSS Studio can stay active in Builder while hidden in Admin.
  • Roadmap: Added Instatic and Bricks common-panel research notes to the product roadmap for future module, media, command, and panel architecture work.

v1.3.73 Dev

  • Selection: Media checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection now preserves Shift through direct checkbox pointer/click events.
  • Preview: Removed the floating large hover preview. Attachment Details is now the reliable preview surface.
  • Bento: Bento view now uses dense aspect-ratio masonry instead of square grid behavior.
  • List metadata: List view fills the available width and scrolls horizontally when chosen metadata columns need more room.
  • Icons: Media Studio has moved back from the Iconsax trial to filled Phosphor icons, scoped only to Media Studio.
  • Sidebar: Only the collection tree scrolls; collection tools and bottom action cards stay fixed.
  • Long images: Pan/zoom now enlarges the real image inside the scrollable preview area.

v1.3.72 Dev

  • Filter: Media Studio Filter is now an icon-only control. Its popover keeps search, active-rule display, counts, Delete filter, and closes when clicking outside.
  • Selection: Checkbox-to-checkbox Shift selection was tightened through the shared checkbox path.
  • Preview: Larger hover preview now uses a safer gallery-bounded placement layer and hides instead of clipping when there is no usable safe zone.
  • List metadata: List view now has a metadata column chooser for MIME type, file size, dimensions, uploaded on, and uploaded by.
  • Long images: Attachment previews now support Fit, Fit width, Actual size, and Pan/zoom modes for screenshots and tall images.
  • Icons: Media Studio is now using the scoped Iconsax-style adapter as a broader design trial.
